analysis_unit: EVA conventional bench units: ckh, cth, cph, cfh, ch, sh; remaining literal letters. Not asserted as phonemes or proven graphemes.
rule: Replace fixed prefix and suffix while retaining a nonempty middle; at most 2 EVA units on each removed/added affix; middle at least 3 units
rule_selection: Max distinct herbal entities, then physical pharma leaves, then min affix edit cost, then min description length, then deterministic lexical order
split: Hold out one physical pharmaceutical leaf, purge every training pair sharing a herbal folio with the held-out set
prediction: Apply chosen single rule or identity fallback to every strict paragraph token; generate actual strings, not choose from held-out label vocabulary
ranking: Smoothed bigram log probability per unit plus smoothed label-length log probability, both fit only to training labels; alpha=0.5 and 1.0 respectively
controls: Identity generator with the same training-only ranking
199 wrong-herbal correspondence trials; family preserved, same Currier/hand/section and clean token count within 20%, never use an inventory herbal as a random control
reported_metrics: Exact label in first 5 generated strings
Exact label anywhere in generated strings, with candidate-count warning
calibration_claim: Exploratory wrong-match benchmark, not a confirmatory p-value or independent semantic replication
semantic_gate: At least 3 independently verified entity families with contrasting localized plant-part captions; operational minimum only, no power claim; else BLOCKED
no_adaptive_changes: Do not enlarge affix limits, prune difficult pairs or swap ranking after results are observed
